Text Description
What are the colors of these berries when they are ripe?
  1. Blueberries are _____ (Hint: Check the name of the berry!).
  2. Strawberries are _____.
  3. Cloudberries are _____.
Possible answers:
  • red
  • orange
  • blue
solution:
1. Blueberries are blue.
  2. Strawberries are red.
  3. Cloudberries are orange.
